name: Lyantei
source:
Lyantei is a visual novel in which you take care of the tavern of your aunt and deal with the guests and their problems.

During your time there you will make many decisions. Sometimes it is something simple; Do you go gather wood during your morning shift or should you increase your food supply?

But it can also get more complicated: How do you deal with a swearing guest? Do you let someone you find unconscious just lie on the ground or do you help them?

Which secrets will you reveal? Will you grow through your experience? Will you be able to save the livelihood of your aunt or will all the trouble be in vain?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1022000/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Lyantei》是一部视觉小说，你要照看姑姑的酒馆，处理客人与他们的问题。

在这里期间，你会作出许多决定。有时事情很简单：早班时要去收集木材，还是增加食物储备？

但事情也可能更复杂：如何应对满口脏话的客人？发现有人昏倒在地，你要让他继续躺着，还是帮助他？

你会揭开哪些秘密？会在经历中成长吗？能拯救姑姑的生计吗？还是所有麻烦都会白费？

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1022000/]Steam[/url]]
